about: Downtown Littleton brings the Original Dickens Carolers to Main Street for the holiday season.
The caroling company has kept Victorian songs alive on the Colorado Front Range for 40 years.
Visits run on eight dates: November 28 and 29, and December 5 and 6, 12 and 13, and 19 and 20.
Each visit lasts from 11 AM to 2 PM.
The carolers roam throughout downtown rather than staying on one stage.
Santa stops to chat and pose for photos as the carolers sing.
The host calls it a wonderful photo opportunity for families.
No tickets are needed and the visits are free to enjoy.
Families can combine the visit with shopping and a coffee on Main Street.
The event is outdoors on the sidewalks of downtown Littleton.
Questions go to info@downtownlittleton.org, the contact on the Visit Littleton listing.

kids: Eat a doughnut and sip hot cocoa with Santa
site: Buck Recreation Center, 2004 W Powers Ave
about: South Suburban Parks and Recreation runs Cocoa and Doughnuts with Santa at the Buck Recreation Center.
The center sits at 2004 W Powers Avenue, steps from downtown Littleton.
The 2026 event is Saturday, December 5.
Families choose one of two sessions, 8:30 to 9:30 AM or 10 to 11 AM.
Santa visits to share goodies and holiday cheer.
The Littleton Rotary sponsors the event.
Doughnuts and hot cocoa are served.
Kids make holiday crafts.
Photos with Santa are part of the morning.
The Visit Littleton guide lists the price at $6.
Registration is online through the South Suburban catalog.

site: Sheridan Recreation Center, 3325 W Oxford Ave
about: Santa trades his sleigh for cleats at the Sheridan Recreation Center on a December Friday evening.
Find the center at 3325 W Oxford Avenue in Sheridan, west of Englewood.
The 2026 event is Friday, December 4, from 5 to 7 PM.
Admission costs nothing, so families can simply show up.
Kids try their soccer skills against Santa Claus.
Photos with Santa are included.
Pizza is served.
Extra games fill out the schedule between kicks.
The district describes it as a fun filled stretch of holiday play.
It is held indoors at the recreation center.
South Suburban lists the event in its 2026 to 27 winter events guide.
